name: Venomancer: Slimy Stingers also procs Beetle Slime off Hivebreak (#9651)
contract: #9651 reports Slimy Stingers (706001) only affecting Carapace Crash, not Hivebreak, even though both are level-28+ Beetle Form single-target strikes meant to proc Beetle Slime (704347). AscensionVenomancerEvents.cpp:93's Check() gated the proc on `Named(info,803199)` (Carapace Crash's chain root only); AscensionVenomancerAbilities.cpp:215 already treats Hivebreak (803193) and Carapace Crash (803199) as an equivalent pair for a sibling effect via `Any(info,{803193,803199})`. The fix widens the Check() for 706001 to the same `Any(info,{803193,803199})`. Hivebreak's Spell.dbc record (id 803193) confirms Effect[0]=SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, EffectImplicitTargetA[0]=TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY (single target, no AoE radius needed), DmgClass=SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MELEE (unlike Carapace Crash's SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_MAGIC, so the fixture needs melee_hit_rating/expertise_rating, not spell_hit_rating, to guarantee the hit), PowerType=1 (Rage), ManaCost=200 (20 displayed Rage), and CasterAuraSpell=803183 (Beetle Form, same cast-time form requirement as Carapace Crash). This scenario casts literal Hivebreak (803193) directly, confirmed via DBC comparison, not by implementation assumption.

steps.label: Enter Beetle Form: Hivebreak carries CasterAuraSpell 803183
Clear the GCD from entering Beetle Form
